practiceQuestions.prompt: Why might a profitable business still struggle to pay suppliers?
options: Sales may be recorded before customers pay, creating receivables
Profit always equals cash in the bank
Depreciation always requires a cash payment in the same period
Inventory never affects cash
practiceQuestions.explanation: Accrual revenue can precede cash collection, so profit does not guarantee liquidity.
